title: High Availability CTFd on IBM LinuxONE (s390x) with Nginx, PostgreSQL 18, and Redis
description: A production-grade 3-tier HA architecture for CTFd deployed on IBM LinuxONE s390x VMs — Nginx least_conn load balancing, centralized Redis sessions, PostgreSQL 18, and a multi-stage Docker build that handles s390x-incompatible Python wheels.

title: Production K3s on VPS: A 4-Node Architecture with HA, Monitoring, and CI/CD
description: A production-oriented K3s architecture across four VPS nodes — WireGuard mesh, dual control plane, HAProxy failover, Traefik ingress, Prometheus monitoring, and GitHub Actions CI/CD, at ~80% lower cost than managed Kubernetes.

title: Managing K3s from an Android Device
description: How to build a hybrid Kubernetes environment where a Linux laptop acts as the control plane and an Android device serves as a fully functional remote command center using K3s, Tailscale, and Headlamp.

title: Moving Data Between MongoDB Deployments Without Overwriting Production
description: The core mongodump/mongorestore workflow, plus the real-world variations: merge vs. replace, partial migrations, namespace renaming, oplog-based continuous sync, and when to use Atlas Live Migrate instead.

title: Locking Down MongoDB Atlas: Tailscale App Connectors for Roaming Clients
description: How I replaced Atlas's open 0.0.0.0/0 network access rule with two static IPs — one for production pods, one for a Tailscale App Connector that transparently proxies operator laptops no matter where they are.
